# TATAZO

> TATAZO is a fun family open-world adventure game for PC, in development (launch date to be announced; wishlist on Steam). Players sail between nine realms, pick one of five classes, tame pets, horses and a winged pegasus, gather, craft, farm and build, and team up with friends to face Aurendrake, the Old Warden. No ads in the game, and a Family screen with a parent PIN.

TATAZO is made for families: little ones can wander and build, older players can master a class and take on bosses with friends.

## The game

- [Official site](https://playtatazo.online/): what TATAZO is, the world map, the classes, the legends and the family notes
- [The wiki](https://wiki.playtatazo.online/): every item, creature, recipe, realm and class, with guides and tales
- [Getting started](https://wiki.playtatazo.online/guides/getting-started.html): the first hour, step by step
- [Classes](https://wiki.playtatazo.online/classes/index.html): the five classes and their skills
- [Realms](https://wiki.playtatazo.online/realms/index.html): the nine lands you can sail to
- [Creatures](https://wiki.playtatazo.online/creatures/index.html): creatures, what they drop and where they live
- [Family safety](https://wiki.playtatazo.online/guides/family-safety.html): how the game keeps children safe
- [Game modes](https://wiki.playtatazo.online/guides/game-modes.html): the seven ways to play (Adventure, Explore, Survival, Cozy, Creative, Hardcore for teens, and the APOCALYPSE night run) and who each suits

## Good to know

- Genre: family open-world adventure with co-op; solo or with friends
- Platform: PC (Steam), coming soon
- Controls: a game controller, or mouse and keyboard; the on-screen button hints follow the device in use
- World types: Adventure, Explore (no levels, creatures never attack), Survival, Cozy, Creative, and Hardcore for teens
- Themes: kindness, courage, helping others and caring for creation
- [Privacy](https://playtatazo.online/privacy.html)
